subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'PLATINUM' is coded as ‘171322110152214’, and ‘COPPER’ is coded as ’4161717619’. How will 'GOLD' be coded in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabet series and its positional value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The logic follows here is: 

(Positional value + 1) is written in place of letters.

 
• PLATINUM → 171322110152214

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/133004a3b396e0e82ab8093e0ecd4193a32bee9cdcf92cd8e9f9ea3d299e08c6.png] 

 
• COPPER → 4161717619

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c878055bbfcdd1ae94f3bc8cfb782eaef1c2fa957a423f83883911dfba77f57e.png] 

 
• Similarly, **GOLD** → 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/285e97074f6b2c470dd65fdc120232fe0731156934a7a0f25d19e3db64b745a4.png] 

Hence, '816135' is the correct answer.
